review_candidates.description: Job Description Project/Program TSMO Technology Program The incumbent will act as Senior Network Administrator for the DOT Transportation Safety Management and Operations (TSMO) Technology Program is responsible for the engineering, secure deployment, and operational management of the critical communications infrastructure supporting regional Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). This role focuses on leveraging Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN to connect ruggedized roadside edge devices—specifically Cisco IR1101 routers—to the Traffic Management Center (TMC) and cloud environments. This role will ensure robust, end-to-end security across this converged IT/OT network using Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls managed centrally via Panorama. Day-to-Day Key Job Duties Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN & Roadside Edge Engineering SD-WAN Orchestration: Design, configure, and manage the WAN overlay using Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (formerly vManage). Implement centralized control, data, and Application-Aware Routing (AAR) policies to optimize traffic path selection (e.g., prioritizing critical traffic signal data over video feeds). Ruggedized Edge Deployment: Configure and deploy Cisco IR1101 Industrial Integrated Services Routers in roadside cabinets. Leverage the modularity of the IR1101 to manage dual-active cellular (LTE/5G) backhaul, fiber connections, and legacy serial connections. Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP): Develop and maintain bootstrap configurations and WAN Edge templates within Catalyst SD-WAN Manager to enable rapid, automated provisioning of IR1101 routers by field technicians. Legacy Device Integration: Configure the IR1101’s serial interfaces and raw socket encapsulation to transport legacy serial-based Intelligent Transporation System (ITS) device data (e.g., older conflict monitors or loop detectors) over the modern IP/MPLS or SD-WAN network. Palo Alto & Panorama Security Administration Centralized Security Management: Utilize Palo Alto Panorama to manage device groups, templates, and security policies across all physical and virtual (VM-Series) firewalls deployed at the TMC, cloud egress points, and critical field hubs. Isolate critical traffic control systems (NTCIP), tolling systems (PCI-DSS compliant), and CCTV multicast streams from each other and from the corporate IT network. Senior - 60 - 84 months: Candidate is able to work independently, without assistance and provides guidance to others. May have an advanced education. Experience with VM-Series firewalls in public/private clouds is a plus. 60 months experience with Cisco IR1101 hardware, including IOS-XE SD-WAN software, expansion modules, and cellular configuration 60 months experience with routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), IPsec VPNs, Quality of Service (QoS), and Multicast (PIM, IGMP). 36 months experience with with NTCIP 1202 (traffic signals), NTCIP 1203 (dynamic message signs), and video streaming protocols (H.264/H.265, RTSP) 36 months experience in an Operational Technology (OT), Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), or TSMO environment managing roadside communications (fiber, wireless, cellular). Palo Alto: Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE).
